Results.ReviewText: I give this grill 4 stars only because I've only had it for less than a month however, I've used it about 10 times in that short period.  It wasn't difficult to assemble, there were just so many pieces to it.  I recommend using BILT app, it will make it much simpler.  The grill itself is a breeze to ignite, and get it up to cooking temperature.  We grilled seafood, veggies, pizza, turkey sausage, and more on it, and everything came out nice and tasty.  I do a basic clean after each use, and a thorough cleaning 1x a week, it takes me about 40 minutes.  I'll update this review after about a year of continued usage.

Results.ReviewText:
My first 2009 Spirit e-310 was purchased used a few years ago and what a tank! I didn't believe in propane and I'll probably never retired my beloved Weber Performer, but I've learned to enjoy the Spirit series. 

You might hesitate from sticker shock, but that all changes when the delicious food has your tatsebuds craving for more! My old grill needed some help so it found a new home. There's many differences between the old and new, but the new Spirit is a Cadillac! I don't know how it's done, but the flavor is entirely different compared to its predecessor. Assembly was a breeze. Follow the instructions to the letter and it becomes an enjoyable experience building something you'll enjoy for many years to come. I'm not sure this satisfaction is achieved with other brands. I grew up with a Weber charcoal grill that my father still uses to this very day. There's a reason why they're those most popular grills for charcoal and propane. You don't hear anyone bragging about its competition because they always wished they had bought a Weber.
Results.Title: Cadillac of Grills
